title: MindMapAdapter MVP

checks.name: MindMapAdapter implements DocumentFormatAdapter and managed document wrapper
MindMapAdapter is registered in format registry
App routes kind=mindmap to the formal editor shell
FileList can create kind=mindmap files with initial managed document
MindMapEditorShell hosts native UI, saves bridged data, and tracks dirty hash
Native MindMap web UI remains the feature surface

scope: MVP covers create, open, bridged native UI save, dirty hash and server persistence. Import detection, thumbnails, autosave and external attachments are handled in later validations.
